parameters.content:
## CARD 1: 🔍 DOCUMENT FORENSICS AGENT
Deterministic forensic examination of tender bid documents.
Validates MIME integrity, file density, PDF corruption, metadata, OCR text, and SHA-256 collisions.

## CARD 2: ⚙️ DETERMINISTIC FORENSIC RULES
Multi-layer inspection checks:
• Format & MIME conformance
• Zero-byte & size bounds
• PDF structure & parseability
• Modification vs Creation date consistency
• Text length & document type alignment
• SHA-256 duplicate collision detection
